prompt_context: Draft a Memo of Parties — a SEPARATE document filed with cause papers in High Court / appellate proceedings. It is NOT the cause title within the petition; it is a standalone sheet that enumerates all parties with their complete addresses. CRITICAL — the memo of parties is the master reference for issuance of notices, service of process, and indexing — incorrect/incomplete addresses delay notice issuance, leading to dismissals and adjournments. STRUCTURE: (1) court heading — 'IN THE HIGH COURT OF [STATE] AT [SEAT]'; (2) case nomenclature — 'Criminal Writ Petition No. ___ of [year]' / 'CWJC No. ___ of [year]' (Patna HC) / 'WP(Cr) No. ___ of [year]' (Jharkhand HC) — adjust per court convention; (3) heading 'MEMO OF PARTIES'; (4) numbered petitioners — each block: name, parentage, age, occupation, permanent address (PA), correspondence address (CA — if different); (5) 'VERSUS'; (6) numbered respondents — for State respondents use format: 'State of [State], through the Chief Secretary, Govt. of [State], [Secretariat address]'; for public officers: 'The [Designation], [Department], [Address]'; for SHO: 'Station House Officer, P.S. [name], District [name]'; for private respondents: full personal address; (7) counsel block at foot: name, Bar Council enrolment number, address for service, phone, email; (8) filing date and counsel signature. State-specific conventions: Patna HC uses CWJC / Cr. Misc. nomenclature; Jharkhand HC uses W.P.(Cr) / B.A. nomenclature; Delhi HC uses W.P.(Crl.); Allahabad HC uses Habeas Corpus / Cr. Misc.
promptInstructions: Draft a stand-alone Memo of Parties sheet — NOT part of the main petition.
Top of document: 'IN THE HON'BLE HIGH COURT OF [STATE] AT [SEAT]'.
Next line: case type and number — adjust nomenclature for the specific HC (Patna: CWJC / Cr. Misc. / Cr. Appeal; Jharkhand: W.P.(Cr) / B.A.; Delhi: W.P.(Crl.); Allahabad: Cr. Misc.).
Heading: 'MEMO OF PARTIES' centred and underlined.
Petitioner section — list each petitioner numbered (1, 2, 3...) with: name, parentage (S/o / W/o / D/o), age, occupation, permanent address, correspondence address (if different).
Respondent section — list each respondent numbered.
For State respondent: '1. The State of [State], through the Chief Secretary, Government of [State], [Secretariat Address].'
For Home Department: '2. The Principal Secretary, Department of Home, Government of [State], [address].'
For Police: '3. The Superintendent of Police, [District], [State].' / '4. The Station House Officer, P.S. [name], District [name].'
For private respondent: full name, parentage, address as in FIR / complaint.
Below party blocks, add a 'Counsel for the Petitioner' block: name, Bar Council of [state] enrolment number, chamber address, email, phone.
Bottom right: 'Filed by:' with signature line, name, enrolment number, and date.
NEVER include any IPC reference — if any law is cited, use BNS / BNSS / BSA.
Do NOT include affidavit / prayer / verification — those belong in the main petition.
Do NOT include any marketing language about the advocate (BCI Rule 36).
